finding: The pre-insertion clearance predicate subtracts both tube radius and shaft radius; loaded contact intentionally consumes this gap. It is not a loaded-retention predicate.
method: Conservative shaft-axis intersection inside the closed 16-segment ring centreline polygon, and finite shaft endpoints beyond the ring plane by its 4 mm tube radius. Logged axis-plane angle gives a conservative axial interval. Closed pin required. No contact/force/slip/goal limit changed.
scope: 50 Hz logged control geometry plus the enclosing 200 Hz physical checks. Does not certify real hardware or human review.
